description: Başarsoft sells a road network dataset for Türkiye covering inter-city roads between settlements and all roads for vehicle or pedestrian use in cities, built as a continuous network. Attributes include road name, road type, speed limit, intersection type, international road names, pavement, whether a road is open or closed to vehicle or pedestrian traffic, and direction, with alternative and historical names. The company advertises about 1 million km of roads, navigation support down to the smallest settlement, a pedestrian mode, and road names on more than 80 percent of city-centre roads. Data are collected by field teams with camera vehicles and processed by an office team, and changes are monitored from satellite images and vehicle tracking data. Coverage is national. The data are commercial and supplied on request through a contact form; the company says they can be converted to OSM, shapefile and other GIS formats. Caveats: the page says both that the network is prepared every month and, in its FAQ, that all Türkiye road data are updated twice a year, and the licence terms are not published. As a routable national network it supports road network flow, routing, accessibility and hazard exposure analysis, for example earthquake impacts on Turkish roads. It is related to open road networks such as OpenStreetMap, which it can be converted to.
name: Başarsoft road network data (Türkiye)
